name: @ci/tool-core
description: The transport- and framework-independent core of CI's tool/intent system: the schema vocabulary (IntentDefinition, JSONSchema, ToolResult), the execution policy (capability, dispatch tier, confirmation gate) and the ToolRegistry that enforces them. Depends on nothing at runtime — no NestJS, no TypeORM, no database — so the MCP server, the LLM dispatcher and a future CLI can all stand on the same rules.
